description: All 60+ currency corridors with current stability tier, daily volatility estimate, and regulatory flags. Sort is best-first (OPTIMAL → ADVERSE). Use to compare corridors before choosing a payment route — e.g. "which LATAM corridor is most stable for a $2M payment this week?" Filter by source currency with the from parameter. Free.

from.description: Optional: filter to corridors starting from this currency (e.g. USD)

name: fx.corridors
